reviews_5s:
Not much to say about funnels, really. But it's still important to note any issues here. They are made of food grade plastic and are thick enough to feel nice and durable. I saw a review about the plastic being thin and coming cracked... I'm sure if enough force was applied to these it could certainly crack them. But you'd have to pretty much step on them to do that. The plastic is fine quality. Plenty thick enough for normal use.

The 3 sizes are nice but I certainly think just the larger one is good for practically everything. I'm not quite certain what I'd need the smallest funnel for, as the circumference is so small it sort of defeats the point of being a funnel. I like the little loop on the end, which is fortunately the best place to grip on to the funnel without just having it sit in something or holding it from the cone underneath.

We use these for the kitchen to refill oil bottles and mostly pouring liquids into things with small openings. Work as expected, no real complaints.As others have stated, they’re pretty straightforward as far as funnels go. For 3 for $8 they’re exactly what you’d expect. They’re not super hard plastic, as you can feel a slight give when you push on them, but they aren’t flimsy either. I thought I’d give one a go in the dishwasher as well and it didn’t melt, so that’s got to count for its durability. We’ve used these a few times in the kitchen and they’ve worked well.This Kitchen Funnel Set of 3 is made of quite thick plastic and seems like it will be very durable. The three sizes will meet almost any need in the kitchen and around the house. The medium size has an opening that is perfect for filling my Plant Water Globes (available here on Amazon), something that was quite difficult without the funnel.

Funnels are simple items, but quite necessary in the average home.

The price point of $7.99 makes these funnels a good value. They actually exceeded my expectations a bit and I’m glad I chose them. I recommend this product.

They are made from a silvery grey polymer that looks good in a kitchen, which is why I got these originally, but I have ordered another set to replace some aging funnels in the garage. At this price, it's basically zero risk and these are great. Material is sturdy and flexible at room temp... I really can't imagine these will ever "wear out" and maybe 20 years from now the material might get more brittle, but they are simple and well made. Great value with lots of uses!I had one big funnel that I used for larger dry items, but it was actually too large for other, finer uses (about 3/4" exit, good for dumping rice into for example, but just a bit big), so these are a good mix of size and utility.

I will say, I only ran them through a hot rinse in my dishwasher, and while the water does get hot, it was not a sanitizing hot wash… they came through unscathed, no deformation or other issue, and they have a nice smooth finish (on the plastic…) for now, I will be keeping an eye on whether they continue to survive heat. A melted funnel is a different thing altogether, hoping for the best.

They are thin walled, but the plastic appears to be very tough.
They nest, and can be hung from a single hook on the wall.
The funnels were free of burrs from the molding process.
They are a little small for most automobile applications. I like wider, heavier funnels for car work.
They work well for adding powders to 500 ml plastic bottles, and other uses in the kitchen.
I am happy with the build quality, and value for money. No complaints.Really handy set if funnels that's useful for multiple things.
